info.name: Get localized pricing by country or IP address.

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address of the user. Either `ip` or `country` is required.

params.name: country
params.description: The country of the user an ISO 3166-1 code. Either `ip` or `country` is required.

params.name: locale
params.description: The locale to use for localized prices, in IETF BCP 47 tag

items.docs: Get localized pricing by country or IP address.
